{"id":"jmap-chat-spec-f82v","title":"federation: a peer domain hosts one or more mailboxes","description":"BREAKING draft change, deferred by Mark 2026-10-30. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 assumes one mailbox per server; a multi-user server (chinwag) cannot follow it without leaking its user list or blocking per-user senders. Found implementing chinwag federation (chinwag beads nuqe.7.12, 7.14, 7.15).

Three coupled changes:
1. Identity binding by host. §Identity Binding rule 1 and §Server-to-Server Methods ('validate all caller-identity fields against the peer identity'): a verified peer domain speaks for any identity whose host equals that domain; each caller-identity field (senderUserId, readerUserId, subscriberId, identity) is checked by host, not compared to ownerUserId. Host-less identities (did:key) still need DID-bound verification. A single-mailbox server is the special case where one identity sends.
2. Address recipients by identity. Peer/* calls name the recipient by identity string (e.g. recipientUserId, possibly an array to batch several members on one domain) instead of accountId, which is local to the receiving server and contradicts §User References ('the identity string is the only user identifier both servers share'). The peer-role Session then has one peer account regardless of user count. Removes user enumeration by peers and keeps the Session small.
3. ownerUserId becomes per-mailbox. Not needed for binding after (1). Kept for single-mailbox servers (ownerDirectAddress, ownerEndpoints, contact metadata); a multi-mailbox domain omits it from the unsigned discovery Session. §Key Publication's 'MUST include ownerUserId' and §Session Object Extensions change accordingly.

Cost: breaks -00 implementations (kith, crate-jmap 0.4). Rejected alternative: keep -00 and enumerate one peer account per user (chinwag's interim behaviour) — leaks the user list to every peer and fixes per-user accounts into the protocol.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-30T18:02:25.308806418Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-30T18:02:25.308806418Z","labels":["breaking","federation"]}
